subject: CS363
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. The selected videos are highly relevant and popular, with top English choices from major educational channels like Neso Academy and Gate Smashers. Arabic selections are the most focused and well-viewed available for each specific computer science concept, carefully filtering out irrelevant linguistic grammar videos.
